en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a long, single‑story stone building with many rectangular windows and a gabled roof, likely a community or civic building. It stands beside a dirt road with some fenced plots and greenery in the foreground and dense trees in the background. A church spire is faintly visible above the trees on the left. Printed text in the sky area reads "Põltsamaa Põlluseimaja".
